blocks.text: Some Greek and Latin Psalter traditions number this psalm differently from the Masoretic tradition. Their numbering reflects a broader pattern of combining Psalms 9–10 and 114–115, dividing Psalms 116 and 147, and including Psalm 151 beyond the 150-psalm count. When comparing editions, the psalm’s number may therefore need checking.

The surrounding psalms belong to a wider collection that holds together memories of sanctuary destruction and Babylonian exile with return thanksgiving, festival praise, Torah meditation, and Songs of Ascents oriented toward worship.
